# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

This project adopts the [Contributor Covenant v2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

## Our Pledge

We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge to make participation in our community
a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or
invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression,
level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal
appearance, race, caste, colour, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

We pledge to act and interact in ways that contribute to an open, welcoming, diverse,
inclusive, and healthy community.

## Enforcement

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behaviour may be reported
to the Principal Investigator at **n.skene@imperial.ac.uk**. All complaints will be
reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly.

## Scientific disagreement

Scientific disagreement is not misconduct. Pushing back on methods, interpretation,
or claims — in issues, PRs, or review — is welcome and encouraged. Attack ideas, not
people.

## Full text

The full Contributor Covenant v2.1 applies, available at:
